@today: button on a database's calendar and timeline views that goes back to today's date
@chooseDate: button on a database's calendar and timeline views before they have a date property: opens the view's settings to choose which date property places the rows
@nameIt: placeholder of the field where a card or row that was just added gets its title
@titleField: screen-reader name of the field where a row's title is typed: on a card or list row that was just added, or a timeline row being renamed (a noun)

board.@undoMove: message after undoing the move of a card to another column of a board; {column} is that column's name (a choice like Done, or No Status)
board.@redoMove: message after redoing the move of a card to another column of a board; {column} is that column's name (a choice like Done, or No Status)
board.@undoMoveColumn: message after undoing the move of a card to another column of a board, when that column is no longer shown
board.@redoMoveColumn: message after redoing the move of a card to another column of a board, when that column is no longer shown
board.@newColumn: title of the dialog that asks for the name of a new board column (a new choice of the property the board is grouped by)
board.@newCardHere: command in a board column's menu that adds a card to that column
board.@hideColumn: command in a board column's menu that hides the column from the board
board.setupHint: Choose which property makes the columns (a status, a select, a course…).
board.@setupHint: shown on a board view that has no property to group its cards by yet; status, select and course are kinds of property
board.@chooseColumns: button under the board's setup hint that opens the view's settings
board.@columnOptions: screen-reader name of the … button at the top of a board column, which opens its menu
board.@newCardIn: screen-reader name of the + button at the top of a board column; {column} is the column's name
board.@newCard: tooltip of the + button at the top of a board column
board.@showMore: button at the bottom of a long board column that shows more of its cards; {count} is how many cards aren't shown yet
board.@addColumn: button beside a board's columns that adds a new one
board.@hiddenColumns: small heading beside a board, over the columns that were hidden
board.@showAgain: tooltip of a hidden board column's button: clicking it shows the column on the board again

calendar.setupHint: Choose which date places rows on the calendar.
calendar.@setupHint: shown on a database's calendar view that has no date property to place rows by yet
calendar.@undated: beside the month on a database's calendar view; {count} is how many rows (of the database) have no date and so aren't on the calendar
calendar.@newRowOn: screen-reader name of the + button on a day of a database's calendar view; {date} is that day, written as year-month-day (2026-10-14)

chart.setupHint: Choose what to count: a status, a select, a course or a date along the bottom.
chart.@setupHint: shown on a database's chart view before it's set up; status, select, course and date are kinds of property
chart.@setUp: button under the chart's setup hint that opens the chart's settings
chart.@settings: tooltip of the button that opens a chart's settings
chart.@summaryCount: under the big number at the top of a chart that counts rows (the number is how many rows); {groupBy} is the name of the property the rows are grouped by (Status, Course)
chart.@summarySum: under the big number at the top of a chart that adds up a number property (the number is that total); {property} is the number property's name (Points), {groupBy} the name of the property the rows are grouped by (Status, Course)
chart.@summaryAverage: under the big number at the top of a chart that averages a number property (the number is that average); {property} is the number property's name (Points), {groupBy} the name of the property the rows are grouped by (Status, Course)
chart.@nameCount: screen-reader name of a chart that counts rows; {groupBy} is the name of the property the rows are grouped by (Status, Course)
chart.@nameSum: screen-reader name of a chart that adds up a number property; {property} is the number property's name (Points), {groupBy} the name of the property the rows are grouped by (Status, Course)
chart.@nameAverage: screen-reader name of a chart that averages a number property; {property} is the number property's name (Points), {groupBy} the name of the property the rows are grouped by (Status, Course)
chart.@captionCount: under a line chart of rows counted month by month; {count} is how many months the line covers
chart.@captionSum: under a line chart of a number property added up month by month; {count} is how many months the line covers, {property} the number property's name, written in lower case (points)
chart.@captionAverage: under a line chart of a number property averaged month by month; {count} is how many months the line covers, {property} the number property's name, written in lower case (points)
chart.empty: Nothing to chart yet. Rows with a {property} will show here.
chart.@empty: shown on a chart when no row has a value to chart; {property} is the name of the property the rows are grouped by, written in lower case (status, course)
chart.@otherSlice: the last slice of a donut chart, which puts together the groups too small to have their own; {count} is how many groups are in it
chart.@value: screen-reader name and tooltip of a donut chart's slice; {label} is the group's name (Done, Biology), {value} its number
chart.@barTip: tooltip of a bar in a bar chart; {label} is the group's name (Done, Biology), {value} its number (counted, added up or averaged), {count} how many rows are in the group
chart.@inAll: under the total in the middle of a donut chart: the number above is the total of every slice

form.@answerRequired: error under a required question of a form that was sent without an answer
form.@notANumber: error under a number question of a form; {text} is what was typed
form.allPropertiesUsed: Every property is already on the form
form.@allPropertiesUsed: shown in the Add a question menu when every property of the database already has a question on the form
form.@tagsPlaceholder: placeholder of a form's tags question; tags are split at commas, semicolons and spaces, so keep the comma
form.@answerPlaceholder: placeholder of a form's text question
form.@titleLabel: screen-reader name of the field for a form's title, while the form is edited
form.introPlaceholder: A note for whoever fills it in (optional)
form.@introPlaceholder: placeholder of the field for the note at the top of a form, while the form is edited
form.@introLabel: screen-reader name of the field for the note at the top of a form
form.@edit: button at the top of a form view that turns on editing its questions
form.@added: heading after a form was sent and the row has no title; {database} is the database's name
form.@addedTitle: heading after a form was sent; {title} is the new row's title, {database} the database's name
form.@addAnother: button after a form was sent that shows the empty form again
form.@openIt: button after a form was sent that opens the row that was added
form.@requiredMark: screen-reader name of the * after a form question's name: an answer is needed (an adjective)
form.@required: label of the switch that makes a form question need an answer, while the form is edited (an adjective)
form.@moveUp: button that moves a question up the form
form.@moveDown: button that moves a question down the form
form.@removeQuestion: screen-reader name of the button that takes a question off the form (the property stays in the database)
form.noChoices: No choices yet: add some in the property’s settings.
form.@noChoices: shown in place of a form question's choices when its property has none
form.@noCourses: shown in place of a form's course question when there are no school courses
form.@pickDate: a form's date question before a date is chosen: clicking it opens a date picker
form.@linkTo: a form's relation question before rows are chosen: clicking it opens a list of rows to link to; {database} is the name of the database those rows are in
form.@linkToRows: a form's relation question before rows are chosen, when the database the rows come from has no name
form.@file: the name shown for a file in a form's files answer when the file is no longer in the library
form.@addFiles: button of a form's files question that opens a list of files to add
form.noQuestions: This form has no questions yet.
form.@noQuestions: shown on a form with no questions, while it is edited
form.noQuestionsHint: This form has no questions yet. Click Edit form to add some.
form.@noQuestionsHint: shown on a form with no questions; Edit form is the button at the top of the form (dbViews.form.edit), so use the same words
form.@addQuestion: button at the bottom of a form, while it is edited, that adds a question for one of the database's properties
form.@button: label of the field for the text of a form's send button, while the form is edited (a noun)
form.@submit: the text of a form's send button when the form doesn't set its own (a verb)
form.@addsRowTo: beside a form's send button: what sending does; {database} is the database's name

list.@addSubItem: command in the menu of a row in a list view that adds a row nested under it
list.@saveAsTemplate: command in the menu of a row in a list view that saves the row as a template for new rows
list.@hideSubItems: screen-reader name of the arrow before a row in a list view that folds away the rows nested under it
list.@showSubItems: screen-reader name of the arrow before a row in a list view that unfolds the rows nested under it
list.@subItems: tooltip of the arrow before a row in a list view; {count} is how many rows are nested under it

timeline.setupHint: Choose which date places rows on the timeline.
timeline.@setupHint: shown on a database's timeline view that has no date property to place rows by yet
timeline.@scale: screen-reader name of the switch that chooses how much time a timeline view shows: days, weeks, months or quarters

scales.@day: option of a timeline view's scale: a column per day
scales.@week: option of a timeline view's scale: a column per week
scales.@month: option of a timeline view's scale: a column per month
scales.@quarter: option of a timeline view's scale: a column per quarter of a year (three months)

undated.one: {count} without a date: click a lane to schedule
undated.other: {count} without a date: click a lane to schedule

timeline.@undated: above a timeline view; {count} is how many rows (of the database) have no date yet. Clicking in such a row's lane gives it one
timeline.@dayCell: a day in the header of a timeline view at the Days scale; {weekday} is the day of the week in one letter (T), {day} the day of the month (14)
timeline.@weekCell: a week in the header of a timeline view at the Weeks scale; {from} is the day of the month the week starts on, {to} the day it ends on (12–18)
timeline.@quarter: a quarter of the year in the header of a timeline view at the Quarters scale; {quarter} is 1, 2, 3 or 4
timeline.@dateColumns: heading of a timeline view's list of rows when the start and end dates are two properties; {start} is the start date property's name, {end} the end date property's
timeline.@span: tooltip and screen-reader text of a bar on a timeline view that runs over several days; {from} and {to} are its first and last day (Oct 14), {count} how many days it runs (always 2 or more)
timeline.@bar: screen-reader name of a bar on a timeline view; {title} is the row's title, {dates} the days it runs (Oct 14 – Oct 18 · 5 days, or a single day)
timeline.@showOnTimeline: button beside a row's title on a timeline view that scrolls to its bar
timeline.@noMatches: shown on a timeline view when the database has rows but the view's filters leave none
timeline.empty: No rows yet. Click New to add one for today.
timeline.@empty: shown on a timeline view of a database with no rows; New is the button above it (common.actions.new), so use the same word
timeline.@undoMove: message after undoing the drag of a bar on a timeline view to other days
timeline.@redoMove: message after redoing the drag of a bar on a timeline view to other days
timeline.@undoResize: message after undoing the drag of a bar's start or end on a timeline view
timeline.@redoResize: message after redoing the drag of a bar's start or end on a timeline view
timeline.@undoSchedule: message after undoing the click on a timeline view that gave a row without a date its dates
timeline.@redoSchedule: message after redoing the click on a timeline view that gave a row without a date its dates
